text: The planned Dunmarrow canal tunnel will run for 11 kilometres, according to project officials who said work is still on track for a 2028 opening. The underground section, intended to carry freight barges beneath the Marshgate ridge, is the centrepiece of the wider Dunmarrow waterway upgrade. Port engineer Selina Venn said survey teams have completed geotechnical checks and are preparing the final shaft sites. “This tunnel gives the canal a direct route through the ridge and will remove a major bottleneck,” Venn said. The Harbour Council said the project budget stands at 412 million crowns, with most excavation expected to begin early next spring. Local businesses have welcomed the promise of faster inland shipping.
